_note: Written by hand by Claude (Opus 5.5, an agent of the v68 round) on 2026-10-29, blind: without opening the v68 training generator, its lexicons and frames, or any other test file; the only code read was the brain's parser scripts/coop/time_phrase.py, to know which English it reads. 240 lines (120 ru, 70 es, 50 en) as speech-to-text gives them, each with the orders it should become, in order: intent, time ({kind for|after, seconds} or {kind, min, max}, after the 60 s cap) or null, and more. It covers the owner's time rules: 'for' (how long) against 'after' (через / in / en / dentro de / a los / count to), idioms with no time (подожди минуту, минутку, wait a minute, hang on a sec, un momento, un segundo) against numeral minutes (одну минуту, one minute), a couple = 2, a few / несколько / unos segundos = 3..7, ranges, 'about' and the Russian inverted order (секунд двадцать), half a minute / полминуты / medio minuto = 30 and one and a half = 1.5, the 60 s cap (12 lines), more (ещё / more / another / más / otros), the time staying with its own order in 45 lines of two or three orders, the ordinal 'second' (второй этаж, segundo piso, second floor), plain orders with no time, and every intent that takes a 'for' time. Each item's 'why' starts with the rule numbers it checks (1-12 as in the owner's list).
